description: Men in shirts and tunics dig deep trenches with shovels and carry baskets of earth. On the left, a stone church with a rose window and a crumbling wall stands beside them. In the centre, a hooded robed man at a trestle table unrolls a plan while stacks of green and pink marble blocks rest nearby. Torch-bearing onlookers in medieval dress stand at right. Oxen and carts fill the street, and a green-and-white striped marble cathedral facade rises in the background under a grey smoky sky.
